purpose: Cover US-17403: the skeleton:reqFields split into reqIntent + reqShape, the decisions:allAnswered split into wellFormed + allAnswered, and the new D3 shapes:draftSettled check for interface descriptions carrying the [draft] marker (ADR-4126).
title: Split checks and the D3 draft marker

testCases.description: A REQ with a TODO description and no shapeClassification fails skeleton:reqIntent for the description AND skeleton:reqShape for the missing shapes.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (ADR-4126, AC-17403-1): TODO description + missing shapes fails BOTH reqIntent AND reqShape on same REQ

testCases.description: A REQ with description and shapes but no domain fails skeleton:reqIntent (domain missing) and passes skeleton:reqShape.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (ADR-4126, AC-17403-2): shapes present + no domain fails reqIntent only

testCases.description: A TAC whose only interface description starts with [draft] passes shapes:tacHasInterface and fails shapes:draftSettled with id <tacId>:<name>.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (ADR-4126, AC-17403-3 / 4): draft interface fails draftSettled, passes tacHasInterface

testCases.description: After the [draft] marker is removed from the interface description, shapes:draftSettled passes it.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (ADR-4126, AC-17403-3 / 4): draft interface fails draftSettled, passes tacHasInterface

testCases.description: A [draft] interface whose kind is not in INTERFACE_KINDS fails shapes:kindVocabulary exactly as a settled interface would.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (ADR-4126, AC-17403-5): kindVocabulary applies to drafts just like settled interfaces

testCases.description: An open decision with a question, two options and a default naming one of them passes decisions:wellFormed and fails decisions:allAnswered.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (ADR-4126, AC-17403-6): enumerated open decision passes wellFormed, fails allAnswered

testCases.description: A decisions-ledger entry with one option and no default fails decisions:wellFormed with 'decision is not enumerated (question, two or more options, a default)'.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (ADR-4126, AC-17403-7): one option, no default fails wellFormed

testCases.description: No check named skeleton:reqFields is emitted; the stage envelope shape (stage, gate, state, checks) is unchanged.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (ADR-4126, AC-17403-8): no check named skeleton:reqFields is emitted
